description: LLM Analytics — UI Bridge Cost Attribution extensions. Adds Cost by Target App chart, Cost per Interaction chart, Page Complexity table, and Model x Action Success Matrix to the existing LLM Observability Dashboard. These components surface which apps and pages cost most to automate, and which model/action combinations are most effective. Data flows from phase_token_usage.target_app (set via get_active_sdk_app_name() during agentic phase execution) and joins with ui_bridge_events for per-interaction cost analysis.

groups.name: Cost by Target App
groups.description: Horizontal bar chart showing automation cost breakdown by SDK-connected application. Only appears when target_app data exists in phase_token_usage. Uses hsl(var(--chart-3)) fill. Custom tooltip shows cost, calls, input/output tokens, and avg duration per app. Backed by GET /analytics/token-usage/by-target-app.

assertions.description: The cost by target app chart shows its heading when data exists

target.label: Target app chart heading with Globe icon

groups.name: Cost per Successful Interaction
groups.description: Vertical bar chart showing cost per successful UI Bridge interaction per task run. Joins phase_token_usage.cost_cents with COUNT of successful ui_bridge_events per task_run_id. Shows first 8 chars of task_run_id on x-axis, cost on y-axis formatted as $X.XX. Backed by GET /analytics/token-usage/cost-per-interaction.

assertions.description: The cost per interaction chart is identifiable

target.label: Cost per interaction heading with DollarSign icon

groups.name: Page Complexity Scoring
groups.description: Ranked table of pages by automation cost. Columns: Page URL (monospace, truncated), Calls, Total Cost ($X.XX), Avg/Call ($X.XXX). Sorted by avg cost per call descending — most expensive pages to automate appear first. Sticky header with vertical scroll (max-h-64). Backed by GET /analytics/token-usage/page-complexity.

assertions.description: The page complexity table is identifiable

target.label: Page complexity heading with FileText icon

assertions.description: The table shows average cost per call for each page

target.label: Average cost per call column header

groups.name: Model x Action Success Matrix
groups.description: Heatmap-style matrix with models as rows, action types as columns. Each cell shows success rate (bold %) and attempt count (muted Nx). Color-coded: green >= 95%, yellow >= 80%, orange >= 50%, red < 50%. Empty cells show '-'. Identifies which models work best for which UI Bridge actions (e.g., Haiku for clicks, Sonnet for form fills). Requires >= 3 attempts per cell. Backed by GET /analytics/token-usage/model-action-matrix.

assertions.description: The heatmap uses green for high success rates (>= 95%), yellow for acceptable (>= 80%), orange for marginal (>= 50%), and red for poor (< 50%). This lets users quickly identify which model/action combinations need attention.
